tier: T1-kin (kinematic rollout on the model's own actions, logged frames; a diagnostic, never driving performance)

family_line: LONGITUDINAL: this read (distance keeping, T1-kin); LATERAL: not measured by this read; TACTICAL: not measured by this read; STRATEGIC: PAUSED (PI item 25)
limits: The lead does not react to the rolled ego (log replay): a gap below the bound is a statement about the plan against the logged lead, not about a collision in traffic. The lead labels come from offline obstacle tracks through the label join; windows without a labelled lead say nothing about distance keeping. One corpus, one evaluation set; a deterministic planner, so inference variance is not sampled. A separated interval is necessary and not sufficient, which is why the rule also asks for the six-seed spread of the baseline.
estimator: paired window differences A minus B, two-level bootstrap seeds then episodes (B 2000, rng 0), engine of q3_read.py / hierrep_read.py; rule of ADD11 with same sign in every seed
